_axes: Roblox studs: X = Blender X, Y = up (Blender Z), Z = -Blender Y. 'center' is the middle of each mesh's box, measured from the model origin (bottom centre of the footprint, on the floor).
_front: Front faces Roblox -Z (Blender +Y): CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + faceDirection) points it.
_notes: CLEAN POP PLAZA back hall (facade only, no inside). Origin on the floor under the middle. Place at hub (0, 0, -52), front (+Y here = Roblox -Z after the usual lookAt) facing the spawn: its front-most point is 5.1 in front of the origin (hub z -46.9), so it stays behind z -46. The centrepiece stage (radius 14 at z -45, 1.5 high) overlaps the middle columns at floor level; that is intended (the columns rise out of the stage). 60 wide, 10 deep, towers 23 tall, medallion top 23.9. Collision: one invisible box 60 x 14 x 9 is enough.
